question: There are sometimes characters who can use powers resembling Authorities despite not possessing a Witch Factor. Apparently, one of the conditions required to “open the door” is having a “profound connection.” What kind of conditions fulfill that requirement?
answer:
First of all, in the world of Re:Zero, there is a powerful force called an Authority, which is used by the Sin Archbishops.

And there are also people who have a deep connection with the Witch Cult or the Sin Archbishops who are able to use powers resembling Authorities. Among them are characters who possess special abilities that have nothing to do with Authorities at all, including abilities that were being developed to counter Authorities other than Divine Protections, as well as various individuals with supernatural abilities who can use things resembling teleportation. There was that expression, “opening the door,” but the idea is that they're bringing in powers that don't originally exist on this side.

In short, being around someone who possesses incredible power causes you to be influenced by them, making it easier for you to open that door. Something as simple as spending a long time together, being blood relatives, or having a contractual relationship like Subaru and Beatrice, for example. I think there can probably also be cases where the door opens through a chain reaction.

Things like distance, the depth of the relationship, and blood ties can play a role as well... Though it ultimately becomes a matter of intuition.
